posts.title: Liars' Letters
posts.description: Liars’ Letters is like Liar’s Poker but with words insteads of poker hands. There’s a fun card game called Liar’s Poker where players get dealt cards that only they can see, then name escalating poker hands that they think exist among all the cards until someone calls bullshit. The rules I’ve played with are pretty similar to those described here . I adapted this game to use words instead of poker
